sample_parse_poker_action: sample a poker action by calling the model generate function and parsing the response with a text parser
use_rethink_sampler: use the RethinkSampler class to sample poker actions with automatic rethinking on illegal or unparsable moves
check_rethink_strategy: check if a PokerRethinkStrategy enum value is a valid rethink strategy using the _is_rethink_strategy method
validate_rethink_template: validate whether a prompt template is a supported rethink template using the is_rethink_template method
sample_poker_action_with_rethink: sample a poker action with rethink strategies like RETHINK_WITH_ENV or RETHINK_REPEATED_POKER to handle illegal moves
